transitions.action: Increment attempt_count, set free_scans to 0, and enter RUNNING.

state_machine.invariant: WAIT is reachable only with attempt_count < 2. Count only scans beginning in WAIT; the scan entering WAIT is not a dwell scan.

transitions.action: Remain LOCKED, including when Stop is true.

timer_plan.pt_durations: None; dwell is measured in scan invocations, not wall time.
timer_plan.reset_conditions: No timer FBs. Reset free_scans on valid reset, Stop outside LOCKED, entry to WAIT, Fault in WAIT, and retry completion.

priorities: Highest: valid reset, defined as Reset AND NOT Fault AND NOT Start; enter IDLE and clear attempt_count and free_scans.
Otherwise, retain an existing LOCKED state.
Otherwise, Stop enters IDLE and clears free_scans while preserving attempt_count.
Otherwise, evaluate the pre-scan mode once: RUNNING fault, WAIT recovery dwell, or IDLE start.
Inputs are level-sensitive; holding Reset, Start, or Stop is not treated as an edge-only request.

initial_values.notes: attempt_count is the retained internal USINT retry count mirrored to output Attempts. Initial values describe the pre-invocation instance; scan 0 executes normally.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
scan_execution_order.action: Sample Start, Stop, Fault, and Reset once into scan-local values. No edge detector is required because all requests are level-sensitive.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.action: Using sampled inputs and retained pre-scan mode, apply the stated priorities and execute at most one transition. Update retained mode, attempt_count, and free_scans; preserve values not explicitly changed.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.action: No timer FBs are required or called. This stage is an unconditional no-op.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.action: Assign Run := (mode = RUNNING), Locked := (mode = LOCKED), and Attempts := attempt_count from post-transition values.
